pending_reasons.VAL-EP001-IMG0303: The elder in the two-figure foreground has a bald crown with a pink scalp showing between thin hair, and his cloak falls to the ankles. This is the third batch running in which he has drifted bald or long-coated. Must be rerendered with a full head of hair described as covering the crown, plus explicit no-baldness and knee-length-cloak negations.
pending_reasons.VAL-EP001-IMG0309: Same failure in the crowd: the elder on the left of the group has a bald pink crown and an ankle-length cloak. Must be rerendered with every head described as fully haired and every cloak described as knee length, with baldness negated for the whole group.

visual_qc_note: Eight of ten frames passed visual review, are 1376x768 sRGB PNGs, are uploaded to Drive folder 1XqRVZAcPjVjPK7EjcQaYLWCxE4yvfYTF and each Drive MD5 matches its local file. IMG0303 and IMG0310 arrived with 12 px letterbox bars, and IMG0307 with a hairline strip, all reframed to full-bleed before review. Two frames are held for rerender because the elder drifted bald and long-coated in both. Director's boundaries held across all ten: no dragon, no dragon silhouette and no reptile appears anywhere, since DRG-VAL-001 is introduced at IMG0316; and no bones, skulls or corpses appear, since the charred-remains line lands at IMG0311-0315. The chamber reads as raw chaotic geology, never as built architecture. Two new flags: small orange vent glints in IMG0305 and IMG0308 read as scattered firelight at that blur and must not become a visible lava source; and the lowland pasture in IMG0304 is markedly sunnier than the Batches 028-030 palette and must not brighten further.
